subject: Cumulus Financial — AWS co-sell runway & ops play
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@amazon.com>, Anna Morales <anna.morales@cumulusfin.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Cumulus Financial — AWS co-sell runway & ops play

Hi Priya / Anna —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Cumulus has greenlit a short evaluation pilot and they want to line up a co-sell runway with AWS for Q1. High-level asks from their side: predictable latency for live scoring, SOC2 evidence for procurement, and a marketplace listing that supports marketplace procurement (SaaS Subscriptions).

Proposed next steps from our side:
- Share a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones (PO, integration, pilot go/no-go).
- Setup a technical scoping call with Cumulus engineers next week (30–45 minutes).
- Confirm which AWS partner motion we use (co-sell referral vs. AWS marketplace co-sell).

Priya — can you confirm the AWS contacts and the preferred co-sell program? Anna / Sam — are mornings PST or early afternoons PST better for your engineering leads next Tue/Wed?

I attached a draft MAP and a short tech checklist to start.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Exec, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RDW-Cumulus-mutual_action_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet, 24KB), cumulus_tech_requirements.pdf (pdf, 72KB)
From: Anna Morales <anna.morales@cumulusfin.com>

Cc: Sam Reynolds <sam.reynolds@cumulusfin.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cumulus Financial — AWS co-sell runway & ops play

Hi Dylan / Priya —

Thanks, Dylan — this is exactly what we need. Quick answers:
- We prefer Wed Dec 2 at 11:00 AM PST for the technical scoping (Sam + two engineers).
- Procurement wants marketplace billing if possible, but they also need the SOC2 evidence up front.
- Our SRE lead will want to review the KV/cache strategy and autoscaling.

Priya — do you have the AWS co-sell intake form or a partner rep we should loop in for the marketplace listing? Happy to share our internal procurement template before the call.

Anna
Director of Cloud Ops
Cumulus Financial

Hi all —

Happy to help. Quick notes from the AWS side:
- I'll be the internal partner rep for the first intake. For marketplace co-sell we need a completed partner intake + a couple of items (SaaS product listing info, pricing matrix, and SOC2 snapshot).
- I'll open an internal request for a co-sell review; if approved we can get the joint engagement flagged to the field team.
- For the technical call, Wed Dec 2 11:00 AM PST works for me — please send a calendar invite.

Dylan — can you confirm Redwood's expected pilot SLA targets so I can include them in the intake? Latency (p50/p95) and expected concurrent sessions during pilot would be most helpful.

Thanks,
Priya Shah

Amazon Web Services

Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:24:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Cumulus Financial — AWS co-sell runway & ops play (internal)

Folks —

Few operational points to add before the Wed call:
- Pilot SLA targets (draft): p50 < 90ms, p95 < 350ms for 1k concurrent sessions. We should caveat these as pilot targets dependent on model selection and sequence length.
- Recommend we propose a 6-week pilot: week 1 integration, week 2 baseline, weeks 3–5 load and regression checks, week 6 go/no-go + procurement signoff.
- I'll prepare a one-page security appendix (SOC2 artifacts, log retention, data flows) to attach to the MAP.
- Laura — please prepare a short demo (10 min) showing latency stats and AutoScale behavior on our Dedicated environment; include quantization/throughput tradeoffs.

I'll update the MAP spreadsheet with these sections and upload ahead of the call.

Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — great call today. Notes and next steps below.

Call summary:
- Participants: Anna (Cumulus), Sam (Cumulus SRE), Priya (AWS), Dylan, Karthik, Laura.
- Focus: integration points for real-time scoring, procurement path via AWS Marketplace, and SOC2 evidence review.

Immediate next steps (owners / ETA):
1) Redwood: finalize MAP and attach security appendix (Karthik) — by Fri 12/4 EOD.
2) Cumulus: share procurement template and PO timeline (Anna) — by Mon 12/6.
3) AWS: begin co-sell intake and advise on marketplace billing constraints (Priya) — internal request opened (PR-8743).
4) Redwood: 10-min demo clip + latency graph and autoscale runbook (Laura) — by Mon 12/6.

Notes: Cumulus requests marketplace billing but will accept a hybrid if AWS requires initial manual PO. They want evidence of log retention and audit reporting for the pilot. We agreed to a 6-week pilot cadence tentatively starting Jan 4, 2027 pending procurement.

Attachments added to hub: RDW-Cumulus-mutual_action_plan.xlsx (updated), security_appendix.pdf

Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
